versions.content: If the swCalibrationAccess of a VariableDataPrototype used in an interface of a sender-receiver port of a SwComponentPrototype is set to readOnly or readWrite and RteMeasurementSupport is set to true the RTE Generator shall create a McDataInstance element with • symbol set to the C-symbol name used for the allocation (see also [SWS_Rte_03900]) • flatMapEntry referencing to the corresponding FlatInstanceDescriptor element of the VariableDataPrototype
